import os, json, datetime
from pathlib import Path
root = Path("/Users/mac/.cursor/projects/Users-mac-Desktop-CHcode/agent-transcripts")
# today Asia/Shanghai 2026-09-12 = UTC 2026-09-11 16:00 to 2026-09-12 16:00 roughly, but files are local mtime
start = datetime.datetime(2026, 9, 12, 0, 0).timestamp()
end = datetime.datetime(2026, 9, 13, 0, 0).timestamp()
files = []
for p in root.rglob("*.jsonl"):
    try:
        st = p.stat()
    except OSError:
        continue
    if start <= st.st_mtime < end:
        files.append((st.st_mtime, st.st_size, str(p)))
files.sort()
print(f"count={len(files)}")
for m, sz, p in files:
    ts = datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(m).strftime("%H:%M:%S")
    print(f"{ts}\t{sz}\t{p}")

import json
from pathlib import Path
p = Path.home() / "Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_inbox.jsonl"
print("exists", p.exists(), "size", p.stat().st_size if p.exists() else 0)
if not p.exists():

# scan last lines for 2026-09-12
hits = []
with p.open() as f:
    for line in f:
        if "2026-09-12" in line or "2026-09-11T16" in line or "2026-09-12T" in line:
            hits.append(line)
print("hits", len(hits))
for line in hits[-30:]:
    try:
        o = json.loads(line)
    except Exception:
        print(line[:200])
        continue
    # compact
    ts = o.get("ts") or o.get("created_at") or o.get("time") or ""
    bid = o.get("bus_id") or o.get("id") or o.get("message_id")
    kind = o.get("kind") or o.get("type") or (o.get("payload") or {}).get("type")
    text = o.get("text") or o.get("content") or ""
    if isinstance(text, dict):
        text = text.get("text") or str(text)[:200]
    text = str(text).replace("\n", " ")[:180]
    print(f"{ts} bus={bid} kind={kind} {text}")
